nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_20
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the player is currently wall running, stop the wall run and proceed with the wall jump.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_21
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the player is not wall running, stop the function and return False to indicate no jump was performed.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_22
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Perform the jump by launching the character with the desired direction/velocity. The direction is determined by taking the current AverageWallNormal (which points directly away from the wall) and rotating it based on the provided WallJumpAngle. The angle is mapped to a reverse range (from 90->0 to 0->90) because the provided angle assumes 0 = forward and 90 = perpendicular to the wall, but the wall normal we start with is already perpendicular to the wall. So if 90 degrees is provided, we do not rotate the vector.

Z-velocity is provided separately as its own parameter.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_23
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Record that we are now in the WallJumping state

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_24
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Disable OrientRotationToMovement so that we can manually control character rotation, then remove all air control. We then grant air control (if allowed via the parameter) after a short delay. This delay allows the wall jump direction and velocity to establish itself before allowing the player to override the direction of the jump, guaranteeing consistency with the initial jump direction/velocity regardless of player input.
